content.title: About
content.content: Flourless chocolate cake is a dense, moist dessert made without wheat flour. Instead, almond or other nut flours, cocoa powder, and egg whites are used, giving the cake a rich chocolate flavor and a tender crumb. It is a popular choice for those avoiding gluten.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Flourless cakes first appeared in the early 20th century as a gluten‑free alternative.
Almond or hazelnut flour adds a subtle nutty aroma to the cake.
The cake is often topped with dark chocolate ganache, fresh berries, or toasted nuts for contrast.
Without flour, the cake has a lower glycemic index than traditional cakes.
Some vegan versions replace eggs with aquafaba, the liquid from canned chickpeas.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Dark chocolate provides flavonoids that help combat oxidative stress.

items.title: Low in gluten
items.content: The absence of wheat flour makes the cake safe for people with gluten intolerance.

items.title: Source of healthy fats
items.content: Nut flours contribute monounsaturated fats beneficial for heart health.

items.title: Contains protein
items.content: Eggs and nut flours add a notable amount of animal and plant protein.

items.title: Mood‑boosting
items.content: Chocolate stimulates serotonin production, which can improve mood.

items.title: Nut allergy
items.content: Almond or other nut flours may trigger allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: High calorie density
items.content: Chocolate and nuts make the cake calorie‑rich, so portion control is advised.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Many recipes contain added sugar, which may be a concern for diabetics.

items.title: Caffeine content
items.content: Dark chocolate contains caffeine, which can affect sleep if consumed in large amounts.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the cake in slices, often accompanied by berry coulis, whipped cream, or a scoop of ice cream. It can be enjoyed chilled or gently warmed in the microwave.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the cake in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 5 days. For longer storage, freeze it in a sealed bag for up to 2 months. Allow it to thaw at room temperature for about 30 minutes before serving.
